Guided Experiences.Description: Immerse in a guided MINDZERO experience which incorporates contrast therapy and breathwork through 2 sauna sessions and 2 cold plunges. (Morning sessions end with relaxation in the focus room to help you remain energized for your day, afternoon and evening sessions wrap up with a third sauna session for a relaxing conclusion.) Rotates guided breathwork tracks that include the Original MINDZERO experience. Recommended for First Timers. Ideal for any experience level.

Open session.Description: Go at your own pace! Sauna and Cold Plunge will be open for your use as you please. Digital timers are provided in both the sauna and cold plunge so you can easily watch your time. Quietly connect with other members or be one with your thoughts. Here, you have the power to create your own experience. Soft Music. No guided breathwork. Staff at hand for verbal guidance and safety. Recommended for intermediate to experienced guests/members.

Silent Open Sessions.Description: Go at your own pace, silently! This Open Session provides a tranquil space with soft music and lighting, allowing peace and serenity to create your own experience through the sauna and cold plunge. No guided breathwork. Staff at hand for safety. Recommended for intermediate to experienced guests/members.

Sauna Master Session.Description: Immerse in a guided MINDZERO experience which incorporates contrast therapy and breathwork through 2 sauna sessions and 2 cold plunges. Concludes with a sauna ceremony- a multi-sensory performance in which one of our MINDZERO Sauna Masters uses aromatherapy and steam, circulating the air with towels to increase the heat and humidity. Recommended for any experience level. Great for first timers!

Drumming & Sauna Ceremony.Description: A guided MINDZERO experience incorporating contrast therapy and breathwork through 2 sauna sessions and 2 cold plunges. Concludes with a sauna ceremony- a multi-sensory performance utilizing aromatherapy and steam, along with live music involving drums, chimes, and sound bowls. Recommended for any experience level. Great for first timers.

Education Session.Description: Embark on a refreshing journey, experiencing the sauna and cold plunge while learning the scientific explanations of heat exposure, cold exposure, and contrast therapy via voiceovers throughout the sauna sessions. Experience our classic breathwork tracks in the cold plunge, and emerge with a greater understanding of the research and benefits. Recommended for any experience level. First Timers welcome.

Meditation Session.Description: Experience contrast therapy through sauna and cold plunge together with a 10 minute hypnosis track created by our certified hypnosis practitioner, along with a guided meditation that will help you set your intention and feel aligned. In-person guided breathwork in the cold plunge. Ideal for any experience level.

Reflection Session.Description: Our Reflection Session is a dedicated space for introspection where you can delve into your career, relationships, and self-care. We invite you to rate yourself in each area at the current time, to help track progress as you revisit the session. Includes opportunities for sharing within the group and time to reflect on your thoughts and personal growth, while experiencing contrast therapy through our sauna and cold plunge. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Gratitude Session.Description: Improve your emotional wellbeing by taking the time to be grateful. Join us on a calming journey of recognizing the many aspects of our lives in which we are grateful, embracing the gratitude and allowing it to enrich our lives. Enjoy calming music, breathe at your own pace in the cold plunge, and be invited to share during the sauna experience. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Silent Session.Description: Enjoy the beauty of silence and be at one with your thoughts as you bring your mind to zero. Follow the structure of our classic session with the serenity of the inner journey throughout your sauna and cold plunge experience. Includes gentle music, a few minutes of pure silence, and concludes the final sauna session with a song shown to reduce anxiety by 65% just by listening. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Yoga Flow.Description: Unite your body, mind, and spirit with a Yoga Flow session. Alternates between meditation and chakra sessions to help you achieve universal consciousness and understanding. Suitable for any level of yoga experience. Includes the contrast therapy of sauna and cold plunge. Ideal for any experience level.

Sunday Morning Yoga Session.Description: Wake up to experience a soothing 1-hr flow session with Vinyasa and breathwork. After that you’ll be invited to join our Open Session, going at your own pace to experience the benefits of the contrast between sauna and cold plunge. Recommended for all experience levels.

Stretch Session.Description: Experience the contrast therapy of sauna and cold plunge while incorporating gentle full body stretches in the focus room and in the warmth of the sauna to increase overall flexibility while relaxing your mind and body. Recommended for all experience levels.

Dance Cardio.Description: Have some fun dancing through the decades and get a workout in! Designed to elevate your heart rate through easy-to-follow dance cardio routines suitable for all fitness levels. Afterwards, immediately join the Open Session to enjoy the contrast of hot and cold at your own pace. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Inner Warrior.Description: Challenge your inner warrior with this advanced session. Experience the difference between doing difficult things individually and together. Includes energetic breathwork, intense sound and visual immersion to energize and summon your power in the sauna and the cold plunge. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Vikings.Description: Immerse in the energetic storytelling of the Vikings through your sauna and cold plunge experience with live guided breathwork, steam, essential oils, and music. Learn the 9 most important claims of Viking life and conclude with a special Viking themed Sauna Ceremony in which our Sauna Master circulates the air to increase the heat and humidity. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Enhancing.Description: Enhance the journey through storytelling, sharing, and connection. Hance leads the group through a growth journey, where the experience of the sauna and cold plunge come together to experience the benefits of collective vulnerability, mindset, and determination to become a better version of ourselves. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Explore Your Comfort.Description: Discover your levels of comfort in the sauna and cold plunge. Learn tips and tricks to make your experience easier or harder, based on your personal goals and needs. This session showcases stretching, breathwork, along with hot/cold contrast. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Four Elements.Description: Feel the power of Air, Wind, Water, and Fire. Includes meditation, tea and tarot cards, breathwork, sound, along with the signature MINDZERO sauna/cold plunge experience for an immersive journey incorporating nature’s beauty. Recommended for Intermediate to Experienced Guests/Members.

Aromatherapy.Description: This session is designed to encourage a mood enhancement by triggering hormones and neurotransmitters in the brain to moderate our feelings. Through your sauna and cold plunge session, you’ll explore a particular theme and mood enhanced by hand-selected therapeutic grade essential oils. Ideal for all experience levels.
